thread:
jamie: incident-bot -> PagerDuty page fired: rp-router-usw2 high CPU (95%) + increasing 5xx proxy errors. link: https://pager.company/INC-7621 :rotating_light:
oncall-bot: PagerDuty incident created INC-7621 (priority: P3) — routed to oncall group
pagerduty: Assigned to jamie (ack required)
jamie: acked. jumping in — pulling recent grafana panels and k8s node metrics. can someone confirm if this is a rolling spike or single pool? @leo @miguel
leo: looking. seeing CPU and load on router-pool-usw2 nodes, 3/6 nodes >90%. tailing nginx logs: a short burst of proxy timeouts and retries. no steady increase in RPS.
miguel: looks like a misbehaving background job hit the pool and caused sustained CPU churn for ~90s. still noisy but not sustained. preparing a quick mitigation: scale up and route traffic to standby pool.
jamie: executing scale: ```rctl scale router-pool-usw2 +2 --reason "oncall mitigation INC-7621"```
oncall-bot: Autoscaler triggered: provisioning 2 nodes for router-pool-usw2 (expected ready ~45s)
sarah: started a reroute: `route-config apply --from router-pool-usw2 --to router-standby-usw2 --pct 30` to shed pressure and reduce retries. logs look better already. :thumbsup:
leo: after reroute, 5xx count dropped by ~70% in the last 30s. CPU trending down on overloaded nodes. still seeing a few retry errors but nothing customer-facing in Sentry.
jamie: I see the same. marking as mitigation successful for now. adding temporary suppression on the PagerDuty rule to avoid a flap: `pd-rule suppress 120s INC-7621`
pagerduty: INC-7621: acknowledged by jamie. suppression applied.
miguel: new nodes came up, kube-proxy warmed, KV cache primed for a few flows — looks like a classic warmup + noisy job.
leo: I ran a quick grep on job queue, identified a runaway job id=0x4f2b that was CPU heavy; killed it and added a rate cap in the job queue service. patch planned.
jamie: good. incident-bot reports metrics are back to baseline. I'll leave notes for postmortem action items: 1) add auto-eviction for long-running k8s jobs 2) add a short cooldown on PD alerts for this rule 3) add a routing fallback in runbook.
oncall-bot: PagerDuty incident INC-7621 has been auto-resolved (no active alerts).
jamie: closing thread in Slack — no customer impact detected (SLA checks green). follow-up ticket created: ENG-9812 (add pre-warm + alert smoothing). tagging @sarah and @miguel for the fix.
leo: taking the handoff for the next 30m to monitor for flapping. ping me if it reappears. :eyes:
miguel: will open a small PR for the job rate cap and link the runbook changes.
sarah: noted. thanks team for the quick coord. :raised_hands:
jamie: nice work. logging quick timeline in the incident tracker and closing.
